claims.text: Texas A&M says CLARKE produces detailed damage assessments from drone imagery within minutes after hurricanes, tornadoes, wildfires and other disasters.

rejected.reason: Absence, scoped to the November 24th Texas A&M release and clarke.crasar.org. Neither names a Texas agency or county among its users. Texas appears as the developer and Harvey as training data.
